dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He's happy just having you back.

dialogues.speaker: Joserf
dialogues.text: That's true, that's true. And I'd be happy accompanying him to do anything, so long as it makes him happy.

dialogues.speaker: Joserf
dialogues.text: I agreed to go build a fox snowman with him. I'm not sure why, but it gives me this warm and familiar feeling...

dialogues.speaker: Joserf
dialogues.text: Still, Dragonspine is a very dangerous place. I'll make sure to keep an eye on Joel while we're here...
